dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Can you describe the urinary symptoms you have been experiencing?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: It burns when I urinate, and this has been happening for about three days.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Are you also going to the bathroom more often than usual?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Yes. I feel like I need to urinate very often, even when only a small amount comes out.

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: She also had a temperature last night. I checked it twice and the highest reading was thirty eight point two degrees Celsius.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Have you had pain in your lower back or around either kidney?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: No. I do not have any pain in my back. The discomfort is mainly when I urinate.

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: She has also been drinking much less water than normal during the last couple of days.

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: That is true. Drinking has been difficult because I have not felt very well.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Have you noticed any blood in the urine?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: No, I have not noticed any blood.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: We should test a urine sample today and decide whether treatment for a urinary infection is needed.
